title: Utilizing elastic weight consolidation (ewc) loss term(s) to mitigate catastrophic forgetting in federated learning of machine learning model(s)

pse.problem: Catastrophic forgetting in federated learning of machine learning models
pse.solution_function: Mitigate catastrophic forgetting by transmitting initial global model and server-based data to a client device for fine-tuning using client data, thereby updating the global model while preserving information learned during initial training

components: remote server storing initial global ML model and server data set
client device with local ML model that can process user input, generate gradients, and transmit them to the remote server

hardware_operation_sequence: Remote server initializes global ML model using server data set
Server transmits global ML model and server-based data to client device
Client processes client data using the received global ML model and server-based data to generate a client gradient
Client transmits the generated client gradient back to the remote server
data_flow: Server -> Client: Global ML model, server-based data

pse.effect: Preservation of information learned during initial training while fine-tuning the global ML model using client data in a privacy-sensitive manner
